## Specification

### Component: Checkbox

A native `<input type="checkbox">` with a custom box. The mark draws in; an indeterminate (mixed) state shows a dash; a "card" variant makes a whole bordered card the target.

#### Anatomy
```
<label class="ui-checkbox [ui-checkbox-card] [ui-checkbox-sm|ui-checkbox-lg]" data-state data-disabled data-invalid>
  <span class="ui-checkbox-control">
    <input type="checkbox" class="ui-checkbox-input">      invisible, covers the box (native click, focus, forms)
    <span class="ui-checkbox-box" aria-hidden>
      <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"> <path class="ui-checkbox-check"> <path class="ui-checkbox-dash"> </svg>
  </span>
  <span class="ui-checkbox-text">                          only when label or description is given
    <span class="ui-checkbox-label"> <span class="ui-checkbox-description" id>
```
- `ref` and native props go to the `<input>`; `className` goes to the `<label>`.
- Check path `M4 8.5l2.5 2.5L12 5.5`, dash path `M4.5 8h7`, both `pathLength=1`, stroke 2, round caps.

#### Props
- `checked` / `defaultChecked` / `onCheckedChange(checked)` — controlled or uncontrolled (`useControllableState`). Native `onChange` still fires.
- `indeterminate` — sets the DOM property in an effect on every render and re-applies it after a click, so the prop (not the click) decides. `data-state="indeterminate"`.
- `size`: `sm` 16px · `md` 20px (default) · `lg` 24px. `variant`: `default` · `card`.
- `label`, `description` (linked with `aria-describedby`), `invalid` (`aria-invalid`, `data-invalid`), `disabled`, `name`, `value`, `required`.

#### Visual rules
- Box: 1px `--ui-border-strong`, `--radius-sm`, `--ui-surface` fill, `--ui-shadow-xs`. Checked/indeterminate: `--ui-control-on` fill and border, mark in `--ui-control-glyph`, no shadow.
- Invalid: border `--ui-destructive`; checked+invalid fills `--ui-destructive` with `--ui-destructive-foreground`.
- Label 14px/500 (sm 13px, lg 15px); description 13px `--ui-muted-foreground`. Gap 10px (sm 8, lg 12). The control is as tall as the first text line, so the box centres on it.
- Disabled: box and text opacity .5, `cursor: not-allowed`.
- Card: padding 14px 16px, 1px `--ui-border`, `--radius-lg`. Checked: border `--ui-control-on`, inset 1px ring of the same colour, background `--ui-control-on` 6% over `--ui-surface`. Hover (fine pointers, unchecked): `--ui-accent`.

#### Motion
- Mark: `stroke-dashoffset` 1 → 0, 220ms `--ui-ease-out`, 40ms delay while the box fills (colours 150ms `--ui-ease-standard`).
- Press: box `scale(.92)` on `--ui-spring-snappy`.
- Reduced motion: state changes, nothing moves.

#### Accessibility
- WAI-ARIA checkbox via the native input. Space toggles. Indeterminate exposes `aria-checked="mixed"` natively.
- Focus ring on `:focus-visible`: `0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent)` around the box (around the card for the card variant).
- Without a visible label the consumer must pass `aria-label`.

#### Acceptance checks
- Clicking the label text toggles the box; `getByLabel` finds the input.
- Controlled and uncontrolled both work; `onCheckedChange` receives booleans.
- Indeterminate shows the dash and stays until the prop changes; the next click checks it.
- Mark draws (dashoffset animates) on check; card variant tints and rings when checked.
- Light, dark and every accent; keyboard focus shows a ring, pointer focus does not.

### `ui/components/checkbox/checkbox.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { forwardRef, useEffect, useId, useRef, type ChangeEvent, type InputHTMLAttributes, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';

export type CheckboxSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
export type CheckboxVariant = 'default' | 'card';

export interface CheckboxProps extends Omit<InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, 'type' | 'size' | 'prefix'> {
  /** Controlled state. Pair with `onCheckedChange`. */
  checked?: boolean;
  /** Initial state when uncontrolled. */
  defaultChecked?: boolean;
  /** Called with the new state when the user toggles the box. */
  onCheckedChange?: (checked: boolean) => void;
  /** Mixed state (a "select all" with some children selected). Shows a dash; the next click checks it. */
  indeterminate?: boolean;
  /** Box size: 16 / 20 / 24px. Default `md`. */
  size?: CheckboxSize;
  /** `card` makes the whole bordered card the target and tints it when checked. */
  variant?: CheckboxVariant;
  /** Visible label. Without one, pass `aria-label`. */
  label?: ReactNode;
  /** Secondary text under the label (wired with `aria-describedby`). */
  description?: ReactNode;
  /** Error state: destructive border and `aria-invalid`. */
  invalid?: boolean;
  /** Classes for the outer `<label>`; everything else goes to the `<input>`. */
  className?: string;
}

const CHECK_PATH = 'M4 8.5l2.5 2.5L12 5.5';
const DASH_PATH = 'M4.5 8h7';

/**
 * Checkbox — a native checkbox (forms, autofill, a11y for free) with a custom
 * box whose mark draws in. Controlled or uncontrolled.
 */
export const Checkbox = forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, CheckboxProps>(function Checkbox(
  {
    checked,
    defaultChecked = false,
    onCheckedChange,
    indeterminate = false,
    size = 'md',
    variant = 'default',
    label,
    description,
    invalid,
    className,
    disabled,
    id,
    onChange,
    'aria-describedby': describedBy,
    ...props
  },
  ref,
) {
  const [value, setValue] = useControllableState({ value: checked, defaultValue: defaultChecked, onChange: onCheckedChange });
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const composed = useComposedRefs(ref, inputRef);
  const descId = useId();
  const hasText = label != null || description != null;

  // `indeterminate` is a DOM property, not an attribute
  useEffect(() => {
    if (inputRef.current) inputRef.current.indeterminate = indeterminate;
  });

  const handleChange = (e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const input = e.currentTarget;
    setValue(input.checked);
    onChange?.(e);
    // A click clears the native indeterminate flag; the prop decides
    input.indeterminate = indeterminate;
  };

  const state = indeterminate ? 'indeterminate' : value ? 'checked' : 'unchecked';

  return (
    <label
      className={cn('ui-checkbox', variant === 'card' && 'ui-checkbox-card', size !== 'md' && `ui-checkbox-${size}`, className)}
      data-state={state}
      data-disabled={disabled ? '' : undefined}
      data-invalid={invalid ? '' : undefined}
    >
      <span className="ui-checkbox-control">
        <input
          ref={composed}
          id={id}
          type="checkbox"
          className="ui-checkbox-input"
          checked={value}
          disabled={disabled}
          aria-invalid={invalid || undefined}
          aria-describedby={cn(description != null && descId, describedBy) || undefined}
          onChange={handleChange}
          {...props}
        />
        <span className="ui-checkbox-box" aria-hidden="true">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" className="ui-checkbox-mark" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
            <path className="ui-checkbox-check" d={CHECK_PATH} pathLength={1} />
            <path className="ui-checkbox-dash" d={DASH_PATH} pathLength={1} />
          </svg>
        </span>
      </span>
      {hasText && (
        <span className="ui-checkbox-text">
          {label != null && <span className="ui-checkbox-label">{label}</span>}
          {description != null && (
            <span id={descId} className="ui-checkbox-description">
              {description}
            </span>
          )}
        </span>
      )}
    </label>
  );
});
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/checkbox.css`

```css
/* Checkbox ----------------------------------------------------------------
   <label class="ui-checkbox [ui-checkbox-card] [ui-checkbox-sm|-lg]">
     <span class="ui-checkbox-control">
       <input class="ui-checkbox-input" type="checkbox"> <span class="ui-checkbox-box"><svg>…</svg></span>
     </span>
     <span class="ui-checkbox-text"><span class="ui-checkbox-label"> <span class="ui-checkbox-description">
   State: data-state="checked|unchecked|indeterminate" on the label, [data-disabled], [data-invalid].
   The native input sits invisibly over the box, so clicks, focus and forms are all native.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-checkbox {
    --ui-box: 1.25rem;
    --ui-box-lh: 1.375rem;
    position: relative;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.625rem;
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    line-height: var(--text-base--line-height);
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    cursor: pointer;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  }
  .ui-checkbox-sm { --ui-box: 1rem; --ui-box-lh: 1.25rem; font-size: var(--text-sm); line-height: var(--text-sm--line-height); gap: 0.5rem; }
  .ui-checkbox-lg { --ui-box: 1.5rem; --ui-box-lh: 1.5rem; font-size: var(--text-md); line-height: var(--text-md--line-height); gap: 0.75rem; }

  .ui-checkbox-control {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-flex;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: var(--ui-box);
    height: var(--ui-box-lh);
  }
  .ui-checkbox-input {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 1;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    margin: 0;
    opacity: 0;
    cursor: inherit;
    appearance: none;
  }

  .ui-checkbox-box {
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: var(--ui-box);
    height: var(--ui-box);
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border-strong);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    background-color: var(--ui-surface);
    color: var(--ui-control-glyph);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-xs);
    pointer-events: none;
    transition:
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      border-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy);
  }
  .ui-checkbox-mark { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
  .ui-checkbox-check,
  .ui-checkbox-dash {
    stroke-dasharray: 1;
    stroke-dashoffset: 1;
    transition: stroke-dashoffset var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out);
  }

  /* Checked / indeterminate */
  .ui-checkbox-input:checked + .ui-checkbox-box,
  .ui-checkbox-input:indeterminate + .ui-checkbox-box {
    background-color: var(--ui-control-on);
    border-color: var(--ui-control-on);
    box-shadow: none;
  }
  .ui-checkbox-input:checked:not(:indeterminate) + .ui-checkbox-box .ui-checkbox-check { stroke-dashoffset: 0; transition-delay: 40ms; }
  .ui-checkbox-input:indeterminate + .ui-checkbox-box .ui-checkbox-dash { stroke-dashoffset: 0; transition-delay: 40ms; }

  /* Press */
  .ui-checkbox-input:active:not(:disabled) + .ui-checkbox-box { transform: scale(0.92); }

  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-checkbox-input:hover:not(:disabled, :checked, :indeterminate) + .ui-checkbox-box { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 35%, var(--ui-border-strong)); }
    .ui-checkbox-input:hover:not(:disabled):is(:checked, :indeterminate) + .ui-checkbox-box { background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-control-on) 88%, var(--ui-background)); }
  }

  .ui-checkbox-input:focus-visible + .ui-checkbox-box { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }

  /* Invalid */
  .ui-checkbox-input[aria-invalid="true"] + .ui-checkbox-box { border-color: var(--ui-destructive); }
  .ui-checkbox-input[aria-invalid="true"]:is(:checked, :indeterminate) + .ui-checkbox-box {
    background-color: var(--ui-destructive);
    color: var(--ui-destructive-foreground);
  }
  .ui-checkbox-input[aria-invalid="true"]:focus-visible + .ui-checkbox-box { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-destructive) 35%, transparent); }

  /* Text */
  .ui-checkbox-text { display: grid; gap: 0.125rem; min-width: 0; user-select: none; }
  .ui-checkbox-label { font-weight: 500; }
  .ui-checkbox-description { color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); font-size: var(--text-sm); line-height: var(--text-sm--line-height); }

  /* Disabled */
  .ui-checkbox[data-disabled] { cursor: not-allowed; }
  .ui-checkbox[data-disabled] .ui-checkbox-box,
  .ui-checkbox[data-disabled] .ui-checkbox-text { opacity: 0.5; }
  .ui-checkbox[data-disabled] .ui-checkbox-box { box-shadow: none; }

  /* Choice card: the whole card is the target */
  .ui-checkbox-card {
    display: flex;
    padding: 0.875rem 1rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background-color: var(--ui-surface);
    transition:
      background-color var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      border-color var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-checkbox-card .ui-checkbox-text { flex: 1; }
  .ui-checkbox-card[data-state="checked"],
  .ui-checkbox-card[data-state="indeterminate"] {
    border-color: var(--ui-control-on);
    background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-control-on) 6%, var(--ui-surface));
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ui-control-on);
  }
  .ui-checkbox-card[data-invalid] { border-color: var(--ui-destructive); }
  .ui-checkbox-card:has(.ui-checkbox-input:focus-visible) { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }
  .ui-checkbox-card[data-state="checked"]:has(.ui-checkbox-input:focus-visible) {
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ui-control-on), 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent);
  }
  .ui-checkbox-card .ui-checkbox-input:focus-visible + .ui-checkbox-box { box-shadow: none; }
  .ui-checkbox-card[data-disabled] .ui-checkbox-text,
  .ui-checkbox-card[data-disabled] .ui-checkbox-box { opacity: 0.5; }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-checkbox-card:hover:not([data-disabled], [data-state="checked"]) { background-color: var(--ui-accent); }
  }
}
```

## Usage

**States** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/checkbox/states.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Checkbox } from '@/ui/components/checkbox';

export default function CheckboxStates() {
  const [terms, setTerms] = useState(false);

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4">
      <Checkbox label="Email me about new comments" defaultChecked />
      <Checkbox label="Send a weekly summary" />
      <Checkbox label="Beta features" description="Available on the Team plan." disabled />
      <Checkbox label="Two-factor authentication" disabled defaultChecked />
      <Checkbox
        label="I accept the terms of service"
        description={terms ? 'Thanks, you can continue.' : 'You need to accept before you can continue.'}
        checked={terms}
        onCheckedChange={setTerms}
        invalid={!terms}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```
